lose sight of…: In the thick fog, we soon lost sight of the small fishing boat.
在浓雾中,我们很快就看不见那条小渔船了。
sweep up: After the party, she swept up the broken glass from the floor.
聚会结束后,她把地板上的碎玻璃扫干净了。
exhausted: After running ten kilometers, I was completely exhausted and could hardly move.
跑完十公里后,我筋疲力尽,几乎动弹不得。
slide into: He quietly slid into his seat before the teacher noticed he was late.
他悄悄溜进座位,没让老师发现他迟到了。
speed up: The car began to speed up when it reached the long empty road.
汽车驶上那条空旷的长路后开始加速。
moveable: The desks in this classroom are moveable, so we can arrange them freely.
这间教室的课桌是可移动的,所以我们可以自由摆放。
dustbin: Please throw the empty bottle into the dustbin instead of leaving it here.
请把空瓶子扔进垃圾箱,不要留在这儿。
unforgettable: Her first trip to the seaside was an unforgettable experience for the whole family.
她第一次去海边的旅行对全家人来说都是难忘的经历。
delighted: We were delighted to hear that you had won the first prize.
听说你得了一等奖,我们非常高兴。
concentrate on: It is hard to concentrate on your homework when the TV is on.
电视开着的时候,你很难专心做作业。
interviewee: The interviewee answered every question calmly, which left a good impression on us.
那位面试者冷静地回答了每一个问题,给我们留下了好印象。
accuse…of: Nobody should accuse him of lying without any real proof.
没有确凿的证据,任何人都不该指责他撒谎。
so as to (do sth): She got up early so as to catch the first bus to school.
她早早起床,为了赶上开往学校的第一班公交车。
demanding: Teaching young children is demanding work, but she still finds it enjoyable.
教小孩子是件费力的工作,但她仍觉得很有乐趣。
technically: The new phone is technically advanced, but it is too expensive for most students.
这款新手机在技术上很先进,但对大多数学生来说太贵了。
ahead of: She finished the race two seconds ahead of the other runners.
她比其他选手领先两秒完成比赛。
fall ill: Take care of yourself, or you may fall ill during the cold winter.
照顾好自己,不然寒冷的冬天你可能会生病。
sprained: He couldn't take part in the match because of his sprained ankle.
因为脚踝扭伤,他无法参加比赛。
electric shock: Never touch a broken wire with wet hands, or you may get an electric shock.
千万不要用湿手碰断了的电线,否则可能会触电。
swollen: Her eyes were swollen from crying all night after the sad news.
听到那个悲伤的消息后,她哭了一整晚,眼睛都肿了。
squeeze out: He squeezed out the last bit of toothpaste from the tube.
他从牙膏管里挤出了最后一点牙膏。
in place: Please put the books back in place after you finish reading them.
读完书后,请把它们放回原处。
ointment: The doctor gave her some ointment to put on the burn.
医生给了她一些药膏涂在烫伤处。
Casey: Casey has played the piano for eight years and practices every evening.
凯西学钢琴已经八年了,每天晚上都练习。
tightly: The little girl held her mother's hand tightly while crossing the busy street.
过繁忙的马路时,小女孩紧紧地拉着妈妈的手。
Janson: Mr. Janson has taught mathematics at our school for more than ten years.
詹森先生在我们学校教数学已经十多年了。
Slade: Emma Slade joined the club last month and has made many new friends.
艾玛·斯莱德上个月加入了俱乐部,已经交了很多新朋友。
a number of: A number of students in our class took part in the sports meeting.
我们班有不少学生参加了运动会。
put one’s hands on: I can't put my hands on my keys anywhere in the house.
我在家里怎么也找不到我的钥匙。
Southerton: The Southerton family has lived in this quiet village for three generations.
萨瑟顿一家在这个宁静的村庄里已经住了三代人。
Joan of Arc: Joan of Arc was a brave French heroine who fought for her country.
圣女贞德是为自己的国家而战的勇敢法国女英雄。
Elizabeth Fry: Elizabeth Fry worked hard to improve the lives of poor people and prisoners.
伊丽莎白·弗赖伊努力改善穷人和囚犯的生活。
Quaker: Elizabeth Fry was a Quaker who believed in helping others with kindness.
伊丽莎白·弗赖伊是一名贵格会信徒,她相信要以善意帮助他人。
China Welfare Institute: The China Welfare Institute helps children and families in need across the country.
中国福利基金会在全国范围内帮助有困难的儿童和家庭。
Jane Goodall: Jane Goodall spent many years studying the chimpanzees in Africa.
简·古道尔花了多年时间研究非洲的黑猩猩。
human being: Every human being deserves to be treated with respect and kindness.
每个人都值得被尊重和善待。
Jody Williams: Jody Williams won the Nobel Peace Prize for her work against landmines.
乔迪·威廉斯因反对地雷的工作而获得诺贝尔和平奖。
landmine: Thousands of landmines were buried in the area, making it dangerous to walk.
那个地区埋着成千上万颗地雷,走在那里很危险。
Gombe National Park: Jane Goodall spent years watching chimpanzees in Gombe National Park.
简·古道尔多年在贡贝国家公园观察黑猩猩。
move off: The bus moved off just as we arrived at the stop.
我们到站的时候,公交车刚好开走了。
